# Table and text compilers

The table adapters support validate-only, same-size guarded insertion, and explicit relocation around the existing confirmed Beyblade, component-name, presentation-pair, and neutral event serializers. No-op compilation must be byte-identical; unknown fields remain raw. Counts cannot change without complete consumer bounds.

The generic text compiler only claims ASCII, raw bytes/control-byte preservation, explicit NUL, fixed-width or length prefixes, optional deduplicated pools, padding/alignment, and explicit pointer rows. It makes no claims about retail dialogue controls, speakers, portraits, choices, or event opcodes and performs no player-name hook.
